title: FilePilot
summary: A local Windows file intelligence and maintenance tool: storage analysis, exact duplicate detection, safe cleanup, diagnostics, and recovery guidance without telemetry or an account.
card: A PySide6 and SQLite desktop tool that makes a full drive legible, then makes every destructive action ask, verify, and leave an audit trail.
role: Solo builder. Architecture, core logic, interface, packaging, testing.
heroAlt: FilePilot Storage Analysis page in dark mode with a treemap, folder tree, file table, and storage summary
heroCaption: Storage Analysis. A headless render from the current build with synthetic sample data.
seoDescription: How FilePilot, a local Windows file intelligence tool, combines storage analysis, exact duplicate detection, and approval-gated deletion in PySide6 and SQLite.
